name: Topkapı Palace
_about: Topkapı's Second Court: pale limestone for the Middle Gate's wall and towers; white marble for the porticoes' arcades and columns and the Tower of Justice's lantern, read against the darker stone of the walls behind them; Ottoman alternating stone-and-brick (almaşık) on the kitchens and the treasury; lead on every dome, cap, roof and pendentive deck, the alems gilt; the painted soffit (saçak, green and white with gold) only under the porticoes, the Gate of Felicity's canopy and the Audience Chamber's eaves, the plain ranges' eaves plastered; marble revetment on the Audience Chamber's outer walls; Iznik tiles and stencilled kalemişi inside the Divan and the Audience Chamber.

rules._about: the flat leads between the domes
the painted soffits: only a portico's, the Felicity canopy's and the Audience Chamber's roof (the plain ranges' roofs are top-level parts named '... roof')
the lantern stage, its paired columns and pediments: white marble over the limestone shaft
the porticoes' arches, white against the darker walls behind
the walls behind the porticoes, the Divan, the ranges: a darker stone than the marble arcades before them
